nodes.description: Public owner address; set to msg.sender at deployment, controls onlyOwner functions.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
mapping(address => uint) token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom and initialised in the constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
Fixed total supply of 30,000,000 * 10**18 set once in the constructor.
Public metadata state variables: symbol, name and decimals.
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Two-step ownership acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner and finalises the transfer.
ERC20 transfer; debits msg.sender and credits `to` using SafeMath.
ERC20 approve; writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without zeroing first.
ERC20 transferFrom; debits `from`, decrements msg.sender allowance and credits `to`.
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(...).
onlyOwner rescue function performing an arbitrary external ERC20 call on tokenAddress.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH.
ATC() constructor; sets metadata and mints the entire supply to owner with raw arithmetic.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance keys and allowance keys.
External call to an attacker-supplied contract: ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...).
External call to an arbitrary token contract: ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
Arithmetic on balances/allowances (SafeMath) plus unchecked 30000000 * 10**uint(decimals) in the constructor.
Library with add/sub/mul/div wrappers performing overflow/underflow require checks.
`to` recipient parameter of transfer.
`tokens` amount parameter of transfer.
`spender` parameter of approve.
`tokens` amount parameter of approve.
`from` source address parameter of transferFrom.
`to` destination address parameter of transferFrom.
`tokens` amount parameter of transferFrom.
`spender` contract parameter of approveAndCall; address invoked externally.
`tokens` amount parameter of approveAndCall.
`data` bytes parameter forwarded to receiveApproval.
`tokenAddress` arbitrary contract parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
`tokens` amount parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
`_newOwner` parameter of transferOwnership.
`tokenOwner` parameter of balanceOf.
`tokenOwner` parameter of allowance.
`spender` parameter of allowance.
`success` boolean return value set by transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall/transferAnyERC20Token.
`c` local result variable inside each SafeMath operation.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gate compares msg.sender with owner before staging newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before finalising ownership.
Only the current owner can write the pending newOwner address.
Ownership is transferred to the caller only after the newOwner check.
newOwner is reset to address(0) after acceptance.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
transfer writes the sender and recipient entries of balances.
transfer performs add/sub balance arithmetic that depends on the SafeMath guards.
Caller-supplied tokens amount drives the subtraction from the sender balance.
Caller-supplied recipient receives the credited balance.
approve keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the new value.
Spender parameter selects the allowance slot to write.
tokens parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom debits the from account and credits the to account.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom relies on SafeMath sub/add for balance and allowance updates.
from parameter determines whose balance and allowance are debited.
to parameter receives the credited balance.
tokens amount drives the allowance and balance subtraction.
spender identity in transferFrom is msg.sender and keys the allowance lookup.
approveAndCall keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes an attacker-controlled contract via receiveApproval, allowing reentrant calls into the token.
spender parameter is the callee contract of the external callback.
tokens parameter is both the allowance value and callback argument.
data bytes parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external callee.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token contract as owner.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary contract that is called.
tokens parameter is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Constructor mints the entire supply to the owner address.
Constructor sets _totalSupply once.
Constructor seeds balances[owner] with _totalSupply.
Constructor computes 30000000 * 10**uint(decimals) with unchecked Solidity arithmetic.
Constructor writes symbol, name and decimals metadata.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the pending owner slot.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowance mapping.
spender parameter indexes the inner allowance mapping.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)].
Fallback reverts unconditionally for any value-bearing call.
SafeMath add/sub/mul/div implement the guarded arithmetic used by the token logic.

normalization_plan.reason: The `to` parameter only exists to select the credited balance slot inside transfer.
The `tokens` parameter is consumed entirely by the balance arithmetic in transfer.
The `spender` parameter only indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
The `tokens` parameter is the value written to the allowance by approve.
The `from` parameter only determines the debited account in transferFrom.
The `to` parameter only determines the credited account in transferFrom.
The `tokens` parameter drives the allowance and balance subtraction in transferFrom.
The `spender` parameter becomes the callee of the external callback in approveAndCall.
The `tokens` parameter is both the allowance value and the callback argument in approveAndCall.
The `data` parameter is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The `tokenAddress` parameter selects the arbitrary external contract called by the rescue function.
The `tokens` parameter is only forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
The `_newOwner` parameter is stored directly into the newOwner state variable.
The `tokenOwner` parameter only indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
The `tokenOwner` parameter only indexes the outer allowance mapping read by allowance.
The `spender` parameter only indexes the inner allowance mapping read by allowance.
The `success` return value is a constant true result of the balance-mutating transfer-family functions.
The `c` local variable is the temporary arithmetic result produced by each SafeMath helper.
